description: You are a Maintenance Supervisor at a multi-site commercial property management company. Overnight, your building management system logged six new corrective maintenance requests across three different buildings. Your facilities director has flagged that several tickets appear to have been auto-classified incorrectly by the intake system, priorities are wrong given the severity of the reported issues, and none have been assigned to technicians yet. One request also appears to be a duplicate of an existing open ticket. Review all six new tickets in OpenMaint (login: admin/admin at http://localhost:8090/cmdbuild/ui/), and for each one: (1) correct the priority level to match the actual severity described — gas leaks and electrical failures are critical, cosmetic issues are low; (2) fix any misclassified category/type fields; (3) assign each ticket to an appropriate staff member from the existing personnel list; (4) identify and close the duplicate request, marking it appropriately. A triage reference sheet is saved at /home/ga/Desktop/triage_instructions.txt with the expected priority classifications. Exercise caution: two tickets have similar descriptions but affect different buildings — only one is a true duplicate.
